issues.description: Empty base_image fallback now forces python:3.12 instead of deferring to the KFP default image
issues.detail: In backend/kale/pipeline.py _set_base_image, the fallback changed from self.base_image = "" (which let KFP pick its default) to DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE = "python:3.12". The adjacent comment still says "Use kfp default image" but the code no longer does. This is a silent runtime regression buried in a UI-focused PR and should be reverted, documented, or explicitly opted into.

issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' duplicated across Python, Jinja, and multiple TypeScript locations
issues.detail: The literal is hardcoded in pipeline.py, the Jinja template fallback, Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage catch path, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx as an exported constant. This defeats the RPC's single-source-of-truth intent and will drift on the next bump. Source the TS value only from the RPC and remove the literal fallbacks.

issues.description: New IMAGE button hides the current base image value and regresses discoverability vs the inline Input
issues.detail: The prior Input showed the per-step baseImage at a glance and allowed direct editing. The replacement is a small button labeled IMAGE behind a dialog with no indication whether a custom override is set. Show the current/truncated value or a badge on the button so users can scan overrides without opening each dialog.

issues.description: IMAGE button is silently disabled until stepName is non-empty, blocking edits that previously worked
issues.detail: The button is disabled unless stepName.length > 0, with no tooltip or explanation. The prior Input had no such gate, so users editing a fresh or temporarily-renamed step lose access to the base image field. Remove the disable or surface a reason via title/tooltip.

issues.description: InlineMetadata unconditionally renders 'Base Image: python:3.12 (default)' for every step
issues.detail: createBaseImageText previously returned '' when no override was set. It now always renders the default line, cluttering inline metadata on notebooks with many steps and risking spurious display before the RPC resolves or on non-step cells. Gate rendering to overrides only, or visually subdue the default line.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside get_default_base_image RPC is unnecessary and inconsistent
issues.detail: rpc/nb.py performs `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function body. Other RPCs in the module import at module scope, and there is no circular-import concern here. Move the import to module top for consistency and to avoid per-call overhead.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously flags two substantive backend concerns and two UX regressions. The most consequential is a hidden semantic change in pipeline._set_base_image where an empty-string fallback (which previously let KFP choose its default image) now hardcodes python:3.12. The default constant is also duplicated across pipeline.py, the Jinja template, Commands.ts, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx, undermining the RPC's single-source-of-truth goal. On the UI side, the inline Input was replaced by a small IMAGE button that hides the current value, is silently disabled until a step is named, and uses a fragile 5% width. No P0 correctness or security blockers were found.
